verdict.rationale: Omnirush is described as a desktop app for working with a coding agent on your own projects. The agent runs write commands with permission prompts, and it commits, pushes and opens PRs, which implies it can make code changes from chat requests. No evidence explicitly shows it turning a plain-language feature or bug description into a coordinated multi-file implementation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language feature/bug implementation, evidence of multi-file edits, hands-on or independent corroboration.
